title: ChatTTSSpeakRequest
description: chat.tts-speak-request@1: the body of POST /api/agent-voice/speak (Agent Streams S4). The desk asks Chat for the sound of one line the agent said. TEXT is the line (at most 220 characters). VOICE is a Chat voice id, or absent for the site default. OWN asks for the person own voice, and only the person themself may ask for it.
